title: Convergence and quantum advantage of Trotterized MERA for strongly-correlated systems
summary: Proves convergence guarantees for Trotterized MERA applied to strongly-correlated quantum many-body systems, enabling layer-by-layer initialization on real quantum hardware with relatively small qubit counts. Directly addresses our Z2 symmetry convergence problem in SIM-2026-008.
key_findings: Layer-by-layer initialization provably improves convergence over random starts for MERA
Trotterized MERA maintains the causal structure that makes MERA efficient for quantum circuits
Quantum advantage demonstrated for problems that are classically intractable with tensor networks
Small qubit counts (comparable to 16-24q) shown sufficient for nontrivial demonstrations
project_relevance: This is the Miao & Barthel paper we identified in the SIM-2026-008 design phase. Its layer-by-layer init strategy is already incorporated into SIM-2026-008's design. The convergence proof strengthens the theoretical basis for our ALM warm-start approach in SIM-2026-008b/c. The 'quantum advantage' claim is directly relevant to our Helios hardware target.
